Package org.example

Class GradeBook

java.lang.Object
org.example.GradeBook
public final class GradeBook extends Object
An immutable snapshot of a student's electronic grade book.

Forecasts use the supplied curriculum plan. Missing future transcript results remain possible outcomes; missing records needed for a completed session prevent eligibility.

  • Constructor Details

    • GradeBook

      public GradeBook(boolean tuitionPaid, int currentSemester, List<Assessment> assessments)
      Creates an immutable grade-book snapshot for the current semester.

      Assignments, tests, colloquia, and incomplete transcript controls may remain pending. Forecast methods require complete results for past semesters where their rules need them.

      Parameters:
      tuitionPaid - true if the student pays tuition
      currentSemester - current semester from 1 to 8
      assessments - controls recorded in the grade book, including planned future controls
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the semester is invalid or assessment counts exceed the curriculum plan
      NullPointerException - if assessments or one of its elements is null

    • GradeBook

      public GradeBook(boolean tuitionPaid, int currentSemester, List<Assessment> assessments, CurriculumPlan curriculumPlan)
      Creates an immutable grade-book snapshot using a configurable curriculum plan.

      Assignments, tests, colloquia, and incomplete transcript controls may remain pending. Forecast methods require complete results for past semesters where their rules need them.

      Parameters:
      tuitionPaid - true if the student pays tuition
      currentSemester - current semester from 1 to 8
      assessments - controls recorded in the grade book
      curriculumPlan - expected control counts for this student's curriculum
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the semester is invalid or assessment counts exceed the plan
      NullPointerException - if an argument or an assessment is null

    • canTransferToBudget

      public boolean canTransferToBudget()
      Checks whether a fee-paying student meets the stated transfer conditions.

      The last two completed exam sessions must be fully represented. Exam results must not be satisfactory or failed; satisfactory grades are allowed for differentiated credits. Every ordinary credit up to the last completed semester must be passed.

      Returns:
      true if the required records are complete and satisfy the conditions

    • canGetHonorsDiploma

      public boolean canGetHonorsDiploma()
      Forecasts whether receiving a diploma with honors remains possible.

      All previous semester transcript results must be recorded. Current and future controls need not be complete: missing or pending grades count as outcomes that may still become excellent. No completed grade may be satisfactory or failed, every completed ordinary credit must be passed, a completed thesis defense must be excellent, and at least 75 percent of all planned numerical transcript grades must be excellent or still attainable.

      Returns:
      true if a valid diploma with honors remains attainable

    • canGetIncreasedScholarship

      public boolean canGetIncreasedScholarship()
      Checks the assumed criteria for an increased scholarship in the current semester.

      The assignment does not define scholarship criteria. This implementation assumes that every graded result in the preceding session must be excellent and every ordinary credit from that semester must be passed.

      Returns:
      true for a state-funded student who satisfies the documented assumption
